title: Normal test actor key-value store
description: Records written by the actor. INPUT is auto-populated by Apify; RESULT, STATS, LOG, and COVER are written on every run. Exercises multiple content types (JSON, text, binary) for storage tool testing.

input.title: Input
input.description: Auto-populated by Apify with the run input.

stats.title: Book fixture stats
stats.description: Aggregate stats over the book fixture.

log.title: Log
log.description: Plain-text log line. Exercises text/plain Content-Type preservation in get-key-value-store-record.

cover.title: Cover image
cover.description: 1x1 transparent PNG fixture. Exercises binary Content-Type preservation in get-key-value-store-record.
